Subject: Thanks for signing up — next step: pick a technical walkthrough window

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood trial! I'm Laura on the onboarding team — this is an automated welcome to get you started and route you to the right person.

We offer two quick options based on how deep you'd like to get in the first session:

- 15 min product overview (high level: architecture, hosting options, quick ROI talk)
- 30 min engineer-led technical walkthrough (we bring an inference engineer, go over your stack, integration steps, token cost expectations)

If you already know which you'd prefer, reply with your preference and a couple of windows that work for you (include timezone). Otherwise, pick a time directly on our engineer calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-engineer/30min

If you have any immediate compliance questions (data retention, VPC, SOC 2), flag them and I'll loop in our security lead.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
